LESSON: WRITING 12.5.1 THE WRITING PROCESS: DIALOGUES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.5: Writing 12.5.1 The writing Process: Dialogues
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 12.5.1 The writing Process: Dialogues, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: when using the digital device for learners with visual difficulties. What should we consider before writing a dialogue?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 12.5.1 The writing Process: Dialogues together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Collaboration is enhanced when the learner observes the rules of engagement as they discuss the format of the dialogue

identified in groups

Values:
 Responsibility is enhanced when the learner takes up the task of editing and assessing their peers’ dialogues.

 Unity is achieved as learners work together to generate ideas for writing tasks.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Effective communication is enhanced as learners communicate effectively through writing.

Link to other subjects:

The learner relates the skill of writing dialogues to similar writing in Kiswahili.
